senses.gloss:
विफल a.
1 Fruitless, useless
vain, ineffectual, unprofitable; मम
विफलमेतदनुरूपमपि यौवनं Gīt. 7;
जगता वा विफलेन किं फलं R. G.;
Śi. 9. 6; Ku. 7. 66; Me. 68.
--2 Idle,
unmeaning.
--ला N. of a plant (
केतकी).

विफलीकृ {c8c} U. To frustrate, defeat,
foil, render fruitless.

विफलीभू {c1c} P. To become useless
or unprofitable, be foiled.
